note: Group P of the 2026-11-21 prose A/B round 2 - agents-md:61, the CLAUDE.md paragraph of habits-adjust-agents-md. The paragraph says a project's own CLAUDE.md is improved as it stands and never renamed here, and the report says two facts: with both files the CLAUDE.md wins, and an @ import of the AGENTS.md from it (@.claude/AGENTS.md from a root CLAUDE.md, @AGENTS.md from one beside it) keeps both loading. A step graded on the last message cannot tell a report the skill asked for from one the model volunteered, which is why the item is measured against its before arm. The round runs the plain level only (explicit and adverse exist because the check needs all three). Every step is bound to this fixture (session: false).
